headline: Shree Ajit Pulp and Paper announces Rs 62 crore solar expansion project
hook: Renewable push at Valsad manufacturing units
summary: Shree Ajit Pulp & Paper has announced a capital expenditure of Rs 62 crore to install solar power capacity across its manufacturing units in Valsad. The expansion aims to boost energy efficiency and lower power costs for the company's paper production operations. Valsad-based manufacturing facilities will house the new solar installations. For Indian retail investors, large-scale capex in renewable energy affects operational cost structures and long-term margin profiles in the paper manufacturing sector.
why_it_matters: Lower power costs could improve long-term operating margins.
winners_losers: Shree Ajit gains / thermal power suppliers hurt
